children: was trading higher after the bitcoin treasury company's board proposed a daily dividend structure for four of its preferred stocks.
MSTR stock was up 1.19% at $163.54 during pre-market trading on Friday.
According to an SEC filing, the company will seek shareholder approval to amend certificates of designations governing Strategy Inc 10.00% SER A PERPETUAL STRIFE PFD STK
, Strategy Inc 9.0% SERIES A PERPETUAL STRETCH PREF STK
, Strategy Inc 8.00% SERIES A PERPETUAL STRIKE PFD
MSTR aims to provide a regular dividend record date on each calendar day, with any declared dividend payable on the next following business day.

If shareholder approval is received at the September 25 special meeting of stockholders, the company expects to pay its first dividends under the daily schedule for STRC on November 2, 2026, to holders of record on November 1, 2026; and for STRF, STRK, and STRD on January 4, 2027, to holders of record on January 1, 2, and 3, 2027.
A special meeting is also expected to be held virtually on October 28, 2026.
Strategy confirmed the proposed amendments do not increase or decrease the amount of regular dividends payable on the preferred stock.
STRF was +1.67% to $105.00, STRC was +0.19% to $98.50, STRK was +0.54% to $73.99, and STRD was +0.42% to $72.40.

title: Strategy plans to effect daily dividend schedule for preferred stocks
